# Wire contract

The JSON an agent or host exchanges with OfficeAgent, read from the running code. It is the
compatibility baseline for everything the C# API reference cannot see. Regenerate both with:

```bash
dotnet run --project tools/OfficeAgent.ApiDocs -- docs/csharp-api.md docs/wire-contract.md
```

## Plan operations

The `op` value selects the operation, case-insensitively. Members are read by these names,
case-insensitively; an unknown member, verb or enum value is refused with `invalid-json`.
Enum members are exchanged by name and integers are refused.

### `animate`

Type: `OfficeAgent.Abstractions.AnimateOp`

```text
delayMs: Int32?
durationMs: Int32?
effect: String
kind: AnimationKind
target: Anchor
trigger: AnimationTrigger
```

## Anchors

Every anchor is written with a `$anchor` discriminator, and read with one when it is present.

### `$anchor: cell`

Type: `OfficeAgent.Abstractions.CellAnchor`

```text
address: String
id: String
sheetId: UInt32
```

### `$anchor: node`

Type: `OfficeAgent.Abstractions.NodeAnchor`

```text
expect: String
id: String
kind: String
occurrence: Int32
path: String
props: IReadOnlyDictionary<String, String>
```

### `$anchor: shape`

Type: `OfficeAgent.Abstractions.ShapeAnchor`

```text
id: String

```

### `$anchor: structural`

Type: `OfficeAgent.Abstractions.StructuralAnchor`

## Tools

Every tool the Agent Framework surface can publish with every opt-in enabled, then the tools only
the MCP server adds. Generation fails if the MCP server publishes a shared tool with a different
schema. Parameter schemas are shown without descriptions.

## Tool responses

Responses are frozen in three layers. Each says exactly what it covers; a response state not
listed under a tool is not frozen by this file.

1. **Typed results** are derived from the result type, so every member, its nullability and every
   enum value are covered whatever state produced the response.
2. **Shared parts** that anonymous envelopes embed are enumerated: the change-target summary of
   every anchor type, and the receipt payload with its optional members absent and present.
3. **Response states** run each tool into a named state, and generation fails unless the
   response is in that state. Each is recorded as property paths and the JSON kinds seen;
   values are omitted because ids, hashes and timestamps vary. An empty array records no
   element paths, which is why empty and populated collections are separate states.

### Typed results

A failure these tools report by exception comes back in the error envelope instead, which is
frozen among the response states. A member whose schema is `true` has a custom converter; every
such member is an anchor, written exactly as the Anchors section above records.

### Shared parts

Change and error targets are summarised per anchor type. Every concrete anchor type is
enumerated from the abstractions assembly, so a new anchor type appears here when it ships.

Target summary: `CellAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.address: string
$.kind: string
$.sheetId: number
```

Target summary: `NodeAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.kind: string
$.nodeKind: string
$.path: string
```

Target summary: `ShapeAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.kind: string
$.shapeId: string
$.slideId: string
```

Target summary: `StructuralAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.kind: string
$.structuralKind: string
$.tag: string
```

Target summary: `StyleAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.kind: string
$.styleId: string
```

Target summary: `TextSpanAnchor`

```text
$: object
$.expect: string
$.kind: string
$.occurrence: number
$.paraId: string
```

Receipt payload: optional members absent

```text
$: object
$.actor: null
$.inputSha256: string
$.outcome: string
$.outputDocument: null
$.outputSha256: null
$.planSha256: string
$.receiptVersion: string
$.revision: object
$.revision.author: string
$.revision.timestampUtc: null
$.timestampUtc: string
```

Receipt payload: optional members present

```text
$: object
$.actor: object
$.actor.displayName: string
$.actor.issuer: string
$.actor.subject: string
$.inputSha256: string
$.outcome: string
$.outputDocument: object
$.outputDocument.connectionId: string
$.outputDocument.contentType: string
$.outputDocument.itemId: string
$.outputDocument.name: string
$.outputDocument.provider: string
$.outputDocument.version: string
$.outputSha256: string
$.planSha256: string
$.receiptVersion: string
$.revision: object
$.revision.author: string
$.revision.timestampUtc: string
$.timestampUtc: string
```

## Configuration

The MCP server binds the `OfficeAgent` section. A configuration file is named by
`--config` or the `OFFICEAGENT_CONFIG` environment variable. Keys, their types and
their defaults as constructed; `[]` marks a list whose elements take the keys beneath it.

```text
OfficeAgent:AllowCreation: Boolean = false
OfficeAgent:AllowInlineContent: Boolean = false
OfficeAgent:AllowRegistration: Boolean = true
OfficeAgent:EphemeralConnectionId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:EphemeralMaximumTotalBytes: Int64 = 104857600
OfficeAgent:FileSystemConnections[]:AllowedExtensions: IList<String> = [".docx"]
OfficeAgent:FileSystemConnections[]:ConnectionId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:FileSystemConnections[]:DefaultChangeMode: String = "Tracked"
OfficeAgent:FileSystemConnections[]:MaximumBytes: Int64 = 104857600
OfficeAgent:FileSystemConnections[]:RootPath: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:AllowedExtensions: IList<String> = [".docx"]
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:AppOnlyScope: String = "https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:AuthMode: String = "appOnly"
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:ClientId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:ClientSecret: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:ConnectionId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:CreationDriveId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:CreationFolderItemId: String = ""
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:DefaultChangeMode: String = "Tracked"
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:GraphBaseUrl: String = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0"
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:LoginAuthority: String = "https://login.microsoftonline.com"
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:MaximumBytes: Int64 = 104857600
OfficeAgent:SharePointConnections[]:OnBehalfOfScope: String = "https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"
```

## Defaults

What a member holds when a caller does not set it, for every public type a caller constructs:
options, limits, requests and plan operations. Enum values are always listed; other values
only when they differ from the CLR default (`null`, `0`, `false`), so a default that changes,
appears or disappears is a line in the diff. Tracked-versus-direct defaults and every ceiling
live here.
